title: Patch test for all element types + hourglass sanity test
objective: Phase 5 acceptance: every new element (Tet4, Tet10, Hex20, Hex8 reduced with hourglass) passes the patch test (constant strain reproduced exactly). Hourglass test confirms the control suppresses zero-energy modes.
scope: Parametrise the existing Plan A patch test over element type.
Tet4 and Tet10 patch tests use tet meshes; Hex20 uses hex; reduced Hex8 uses hex.
Add a dedicated hourglass-suppression test: trigger an hourglass mode by perturbing the nodal displacement field along the hourglass basis, confirm the internal force resists it.
implementation_steps: For each triple, construct a small mesh of that element type (5 elements is enough).
Apply a uniform strain via Dirichlet BCs and solve.
Assert constant stress to 1e-12 across elements.
For the hourglass test, initialize u along an hourglass mode and run compute_internal_force — the force must be non-zero and opposite to the mode.
acceptance_criteria: All element types pass the patch test to 1e-12.
Hourglass suppression test confirms non-zero resisting force on hourglass modes.
Reduced Hex8 WITHOUT hourglass control fails the suppression test (regression guard).
risks: Tet4 volumetric locking on incompressible SVK could give wrong patch-test stress. Mitigation: run the patch test with nu < 0.4 to stay well away from incompressibility.
completion_notes: Phase 5 acceptance achieved: patch test passes on every new element type.
Max normalised interior-force residual: 1.05e-15 (Hex20); Tet4 and reduced+FB at exact zero.
Added verify/_patch_test_kernels.py with topology-agnostic SVK internal force.
run_patch_test_parametric extends verify/patch_test.py; adds FB hourglass when reduced.
Hourglass suppression confirmed: reduced Hex8 without FB produces 0 force on HG mode; with FB produces 3.48e+11 resisting.
Full fast suite: 1201 passed + 1 skipped + 0 failed (TODO-cleanup gate P6T5 green).
Phase 5 leaves branch in clean state for Phase 6 handoff.
